recipe.visualDefinition: A high-grain, vintage 1970s beach scene featuring a group of people emerging from white sea foam, characterized by a split composition with a large sandy foreground and vibrant, flat-color geometric callouts for text.
coreVisualRelationships: Dynamic white sea foam contrasting against a flat, warm-toned sandy beach.
Saturated pink and teal circular callouts balancing the upper corners.
Bold, rounded display typography anchored in the lower third of the composition.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and visible printing texture.
Desaturated, warm-toned color palette for the photograph.
High-contrast, flat-color graphic elements (circles and text).

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are mid-ground, partially obscured by waves, occupying the horizontal center band.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold pink title in the lower third acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left pink circle, moves through the subjects in the surf, and rests on the main title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive sandy foreground provides significant negative space for the primary title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale sand and muted blue-grey water (background).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant bubblegum pink and teal (graphic elements).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, low-saturation photography paired with high-saturation, flat-color graphic overlays.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded, heavy sans-serif with geometric influences.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with rounded terminals.
Lowercase 'n' used as a connector in the title.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'n' scaled to match the x-height of the uppercase letters.
Single quotation marks used as decorative framing.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed sans-serif for secondary metadata inside circular callouts.
graphicDevices: Solid color circles (pink and teal) with 80% opacity or hard edges.
Small rectangular logo frame in the bottom right corner.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and rounded terminals perfectly.
Commonly available alternative with similar geometry.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A vintage 1970s style photograph of a group of people playing in ocean waves at the beach. The water is churning with white foam. The bottom half of the image is a wide expanse of tan sand. Apply heavy film grain, slight desaturation, and a warm color cast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, rounded pink title centered in the sandy area. Place a pink circle in the top left and a teal circle in the top right, both containing small, condensed black sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible across the entire image?
Are the pink and teal colors vibrant against the muted photo?
Is the main title font sufficiently heavy and rounded?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the promotional text
Record label logo in the corner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the sand.
Check that the circles do not obscure the subjects' faces.
Verify the 'n' connector is styled correctly in the title.
Confirm the halftone/grain effect is consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grain-heavy 70s beach photo with a 50/50 sand-to-surf ratio, then anchor the layout with bold rounded pink display type in the negative space of the sand.
